name: australian-estate-planning
description: Assemble NSW estate planning documents — a will, an enduring power of attorney and an appointment of enduring guardian — by extracting a provenance-cited instruction record from a completed instruction sheet, halting at a solicitor confirmation gate, and filling the firm's own precedents at explicit markers only, with a change manifest and gap report for every fill and no document ever drafted from scratch.

interface.shortDescription: Fills the firm's NSW will, enduring POA and enduring guardianship precedents from a confirmed instruction record. A solicitor confirms every step.
interface.longDescription: Ingests a completed client instruction sheet, extracts a canonical instruction record in which every field carries its provenance in the sheet or is marked cannot be determined, and halts at a solicitor confirmation gate before any document work begins. Once the record is confirmed, the workflow fills the firm's own precedents — a will, an enduring power of attorney and an appointment of enduring guardian for New South Wales — at factual {{field_name}} markers and registered {{clause_choice:clause_point}} markers, never rewriting precedent wording. A connected drafting playbook may identify a registered verbatim clause variant, but the responsible solicitor confirms it before insertion and every unresolved choice makes that document NOT READY. Every fill returns a change manifest reconciling the output against the precedent, a gap report, and dated execution-formalities references verified against the official NSW legislation publisher. No precedent means no draft: the workflow fails closed rather than composing documents itself.
defaultPrompt: Extract an instruction record from this completed estate planning instruction sheet.
Present the extraction table with provenance for my confirmation before drafting anything.
Fill the firm's NSW will precedent from the confirmed instruction record.
Fill the enduring power of attorney and appointment of enduring guardian precedents for the same client.
Show me the change manifest and gap report for the last fill.
List the execution requirements for each document and where each one comes from.
